fichas.title: Bakery
fichas.summary: Bakery planning organizes storage, production, sales, building services, administration, and social or ancillary rooms around the production workflow. Separate bakery and pastry workrooms according to their differing climate requirements. Workroom area accounts for equipment, handling and processing, intermediate storage, side counters, circulation, and lost space. The page also shows example bakery and large-bakery floor plans.
uses: Store raw materials, ingredients, and packaging; keep daily supplies in work areas.
Prepare, process, ferment, and bake dough; cool and store finished products.
Separate warm, humid bakery work from cooler pastry work.
Sell finished products and dispatch goods.
Plan room connections and work processes to support short routes between storage and work areas.
furniture_equipment: Sink with floor drain and dishwasher
